messages:
Ryan Park: Hi team! Ryan here, joining Eng-Platform today. Remote (PST). Quick setup Qs: how do I enroll MDM and get VPN running? Who to ping for access to 'dataplane-prod' read-only? Also coffee: long black. Fun fact: I make small-batch strawberry jam every summer. Two truths & a lie: played in a punk band, climbed Mount Fuji, allergic to strawberries. :wave:
Zoe Liu: Welcome Ryan!! I'm your onboarding buddy  I'll DM the MDM link. Short steps: accept Okta invite, run the MDM enroll link, then WireGuard profile auto-provisions. If the WireGuard profile doesn't appear, reply here and tag IT Help. :tada:
IT Help: Hey Ryan  laptop assigned (asset R-9910). MDM tip: open the Company MDM app, paste code 451207. If mac shows "Profile installation failed", run `sudo profiles renew -type enrollment` then reboot. WireGuard: `brew install wireguard-tools` then import the .conf from your email and run `wg-quick up redwood`. If `wg-quick` errors, paste the output.
Onboarding Bot: account-created: GitHub invite sent; Slack: added to #eng-platform and #new-hires; Calendar: 1:1 with Zoe scheduled.
Marcus Li: For dataplane access, open an infra ticket with project `dataplane-prod` and request `roles/viewer`. Tag me and I'll expedite. For a quick demo creds for local dev you can use the `dev-dataplane-temp` role for 24h.
Ryan Park: Thanks all! One more: how do I request a second monitor and a headset? Also where's the tiny-model starter repo to try inference locally?
IT Help: Equipment: https://intranet.redwood/equipment-request -> choose "peripherals" -> priority "new hire". Starter repo: `git@github.com:redwood/inference-starter.git` -> `cd inference-starter && make setup && ./run_demo.sh --model tiny`. If CUDA OOM, try `DEVICE=cpu` or set `export TORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=max_split_size_mb:128`.
Zoe Liu: When you have a minute, drop a 1-paragraph intro in #general. People love jam stories. :)
Ryan Park: Will do — jam story incoming. I think the strawberry allergy is the lie (I do eat them). :strawberry: :guitar:
